fix.summary: Remove the card requirement from the Trail Club 30-day trial signup so customers can join with no credit card, as the ad promises.
fix.rationale: The ad explicitly promises 'No credit card required,' but the join page says 'A card is required to start your trial,' so the funnel's card requirement is the hidden condition to remove.
steps: Go to Store admin > Trail Club > Trial settings for the /store/trail-club join page.
Set 'Require payment card to start trial' to Off so the trial can start with account details only.
In Join form > Payment step, delete the text 'A card is required to start your trial' and remove the mandatory card fields.
Check by opening http://localhost:3000/store/trail-club in a private window and confirming you can start the 30-day trial without entering a card.
